frequency_question: What proportion of substantive executive appointments that reach the Senate floor successfully achieve a confirmed floor vote prior to the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations for cabinet-level or major regulatory agency head positions sent to the Senate; excludes nominations withdrawn before committee reporting due to non-procedural reasons.
window: Within a 56-day window from formal submission or active consideration.
coverage_note: 12 named recent cabinet/agency head confirmations; historical baseline for floor-reaching nominees is extremely high barring rare floor defeats.
known_gaps: Excludes extreme outlier recess appointments or catastrophic withdrawal scandals prior to floor scheduling.
skeleton: Recent historical cohort of major executive branch nominees reaching the Senate floor stage.
multiplier: 12 hits out of 12 relevant floor-reaching nominations in the sample period.
validity_reason: Remains valid through the current presidential term structure and Senate confirmation rules.
